# Reviso for DeepSeek Harness

Reviso lets a coding agent publish its work for human review, then find the same
document again from

the session that created it. This repository is the
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) integration.
## What it provides

- `reviso_publish` host tool: create or update a Reviso document from an agent
session without expos

ing the Reviso access token to the browser.
- A Reviso sidebar entry and global document browser.
-

A session-scoped Reviso panel with an embedded, read-only document view.
- A same-origin OAuth bridg

e. Tokens remain in DSH credentials; the browser
receives only a short-lived embed URL.
- Host-media
ted **Open in Reviso** and opaque-origin iframe handling.

The Reviso server, CLI, and cross-agent MCP integration live in their own
repositories. This package
is only the DSH host adapter.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with plugin/profile support.
- A Reviso account or a compatible self-hosted Revis

o server.
- Node.js 22 or newer for development.

When `embedOrigin` is omitted, the adapter accepts only the authenticated

oes not trust an arbitrary origin discovered from API

## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`pnpm run check` runs the unit/integration suite, rebuilds the client bundle,
inspects the packed ta

rball, and installs that tarball into a temporary prefix
to verify its ESM import. When a local `dsh

` executable is unavailable, the
real Host ToolRuntime integration test reports `skip`; the public G

itHub CI does
not claim to have executed a real Host smoke test in that environment.

The published npm tarball contains 12 files, including `index.js`, `host/`
(credentials, errors, gen

eration, and OAuth modules), the rebuilt `lib/client.js`,
`cordis.patch.yml`, `README.md`, `SECURITY

.md`, and `docs/client-face-contract.md`. Generated client code is validated by the
packed-tarball c

and `docs/client-face-contract.md`. Generated client code is validated by the
packed-tarball check.
## Security model

- The Reviso access and refresh tokens stay in DSH credentials.
- The browser never receives a `rak_

` token.
- The embed iframe uses `sandbox="allow-scripts"` and intentionally runs as an
opaque origi

n.
- Iframe messages are accepted only from the current iframe. Because the frame
is intentionally s

andboxed without `allow-same-origin`, its browser message
origin is `null`; document identity and UR

L are still checked against the
canonical host URL.
- External navigation is performed by the DSH pa

rent after validation. The
sandbox does not grant popup or same-origin privileges.
- Embed sessions

are short-lived, document-scoped, one-time-code sessions and
are revoked when their host surface is

cument-scoped, one-time-code sessions and
are revoked when their host surface is closed or replaced.
See SECURITY.md and docs/client-face-contract.md.
